{{Top|leg}}
A '''Level One Emergency Alert''' was an emergency broadcast issued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Interstellar Travel Council]] when a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] posed an incredibly high threat to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Council was forced to issue an alert when the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] became the origin of a [[rakghoul]] outbreak that spread to multiple Republic, Imperial, and neutral systems.
